title: Probe provenance and curation checklist for ops
content:
Purpose:
This note captures a small, portable playbook for probe provenance, curation, and small-scale dashboard composition focused on fast investigation for inference operators. The goal: make each probe self-describing, easy to test, and cheap to run so that operators can triage latency/cold-cache/regression incidents quickly without digging through trace noise.

High-level principles (one-liners):
- Self-describe: every probe must include an immutable provenance header (who, why, SLO, sampling budget, expected signal).
- Investigation-first: design probes to return minimal contextual state that helps reconstruct a session (tenant id, model id, route, kv-warmth index).
- Cost-aware: probes are low-frequency by default and have explicit sampling and cost tags.
- Rollback safe: probes should be feature-flagged and reversible; dashboards must degrade gracefully when a probe is retired.

Probe provenance header (required fields):
- probe_id: unique slug (e.g., probe-backend-warm-start-2024-11)
- owner: name and pager alias (e.g., Priya Patel / #oncall-observability)
- intent: short phrase (e.g., "detect kvcache cold-start impact on 99th pct lat")
- query_spec: description + link to SQL/trace query/resource used
- slo_target: desired SLO and evaluation window (e.g., p99 < 250ms over 5m)
- sampling_budget: tokens/requests per hour and fiscal_cost_budget tag
- retention_tier: raw_trace | summarized | aggregated (choose one)
- creation_date and last_review_date
- related_rollout: model or feature flag id (if applicable)

Probe types and patterns (short):
- synthetic-light: single short prompt routed through common path; used for p50/p90 trend detection; cheap, frequent (1/min per region).
- synthetic-heavy: longer context, KV prefetch behavior; used for KV-warmth and sequence-length regressions; run on-demand or low cadence (1/15m).
- canary-sample: traffic-mirroring probe for canaries; captures real-client routing metadata; only enabled during canary windows; sampling_budget strict.
- client-replay: deterministic replay of a failing request in a sandboxed environment; expensive, flagged, audit logged.

Minimal probe payload (what we record per probe):
- timestamp
- probe_id
- route
- model_variant
- tenant_id_hash (one-way hash, not PII)
- kv_warmth_score (0-1)
